The '''Sons of Palawa''' were a warrior tribal group that resided on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. This group had resided in settlements that were located in a [[Tribal Settlement Cave|cave system]] in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]]. They were noted for being a warrior people who believed in a code of honor and blood-feuds. This tribe traded with the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] and received [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that were linked to an old archaeological site concerning ancient alien technology. It was these droids that attracted an agent of the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] who killed numerous Sons of Palawa thus attracting a blood-feud from them.<ref name="TOR" />

Afterwards, a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] device transformed [[Perrin (Imperial Reclamation Service)|Perrin]] into an infected being who headed towards the Sons of Palawa settlement. This led to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] contemplating eliminating either the infected before they spread or destroying the entire Sons settlement in order to contain the rampant alien technology.
